Interface PowerAlertConfiguration

All Known Implementing Classes:
PowerAlertConfigurationJson
public interface PowerAlertConfiguration
Read-only model representing a power alert configuration returned by the IBX SmartView power-events API. A power alert configuration defines the condition (event type and threshold) that triggers an alert, the recipients to notify, and the assets being monitored, scoped by level type (CAGE, CABINET, or CIRCUIT).
